styleSelection.reason: Loose landscape: two connected value washes carry luminous yellow-green ridges and cool oak masses, with sparse dry sepia branches and path turns.

families.referenceCue: Distant subdued blue-grey oak belt. Connected light wash, dry, cool shadow groups; few internal pen lines.
Sunlit yellow-green upper right ridge and cream descending track. Light field wash with crisp irregular tree silhouettes.
Narrow luminous left ridge and winding cream path. Continuous light corridor between dark groves.
Broad interlocking blue-grey and olive canopies. Connected pale foundation, fully dry, then cool shadow glazes across neighboring trees.
Spreading central oak at the path bend. Olive-grey crown, deep cool trunk-side shadow and selective tapering sepia forks against light gaps.
Near left woodland forms the strongest connected dark. Cool base, dry shadow glaze, a few directional branches; no leaf stipple.
Broad lower yellow-green slope. Continuous light field wash, paper tooth, subdued olive terrain turns and dry tree shadows.
Cream winding track. Near-paper core held by target light mask, pale ochre margins and broken shaded edges.
